{{Quote|The mercenary army of Whirl-Point-Six carried cannons that spat out hailstorms of energy so thick they appeared as constant beams of fire.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]], [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]]|<ref name="WarfareCut4">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
'''Whirl-Point-Six''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Army/Legends|army]] associated with [[Waymancy Hollow]]. During the [[Waymancy Storm]] of [[7811 BBY]], Waymancy's religiously-motivated war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], its forces carried rapid-fire [[pulse-wave cannon]]s that dramatically outclassed the weapons of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], putting the Republic at an extreme disadvantage until it [[Sif-Alulan process|reverse-engineered]] Waymancy weapons and [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] captured at [[Sif-Alula]].<ref name="WarfareCut4" />
